name: family_photo
description: a daguerreotype on the sideboard showing the blackwood family: augustus, eleanor, and five children ranging from a teenager to a baby. the youngest child — a girl of about three — has a blank, blurred face, as if she moved during the exposure. but photography in 1891 required sitting still for minutes.

params.success_message: you hold the photograph closer. the youngest child's face isn't blurred by movement — it's been deliberately scratched out. but beneath the scratches, you can just make out a small, sad face. the name on the back: 'eleanor the younger, age 3. taken october 1890.'
